title: Butternut Squash and Green Curry Soup
description: A creamy Thai-inspired butternut squash soup with coconut milk, green curry paste, fish sauce, and a crunchy peanut-coconut garnish.

ingredients.name: neutral oil or melted coconut oil

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven or soup pot over medium-high heat.
Add the shallots, ginger, lemongrass, and a generous pinch of salt.
Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until the shallots are tender and lightly browned, about 18 minutes.
Add the butternut squash, coconut milk, curry paste, fish sauce, and water or stock.
Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook until the squash is tender, about 25 minutes.
While the soup cooks, make the garnish by combining the peanuts, coconut flakes, fish sauce, sliced chiles, oil, minced lemongrass, sugar, and lime leaves if using.
Spread the mixture onto a baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, stirring every 3 minutes after the first 10 minutes, until golden brown.
Transfer the garnish immediately to a bowl to prevent overcooking.
Remove the soup from heat and discard the lemongrass stalks.
Purée the soup with an immersion blender or in batches using a blender until smooth.
Adjust seasoning and thin with more water or stock if needed.
Serve hot topped with basil, lime wedges, and the peanut-coconut garnish.
